_README: Typed port manifest per the Connection Standard (CONNECTORS.md). The composer wires two ports iff their `type` matches a name in the shared vocabulary (types.json). `name` is the literal wiring address: an input is read under state[name] (or context[name]); an output is written under output[name]. The `_checked` block records corpus + OSS audit freshness per docs/architecture/corpus-oss-sweep.md.

inputs.name: pipeline_rows
inputs.desc: Pre-fetched sales-pipeline rows (result of sales_pipeline.list_pipeline()): list of {tenant_id, tenant_slug, display_name, pipeline_state:{stage, stage_changed_at, deal_value_estimate_usd, deal_value_currency}}.

inputs.name: actionable_stages
inputs.desc: Optional override of the actionable stage set; defaults to {discovery, blueprint, proposal, pilot}.

inputs.name: now
inputs.desc: Reference time (ISO string) for days_in_stage. Absent -> every deal reports days_in_stage=0.

outputs.name: candidates
outputs.desc: Actionable deals turned into always-fed work-item directives routed to Tim (persona_project_id=8), ranked days_in_stage DESC then deal_value DESC. Each: {directive, persona_project_id, tenant_id, correlation_id, requires_worker_type}.

outputs.name: skipped
outputs.desc: Non-actionable rows (lead/qualified/retained/churned/unknown) with a skip reason.

_proposed_types_note: These types are not yet in the orchestrator's types.json. They mirror the always-fed candidate contract and sales_pipeline row shape; described here for vocabulary review (CONNECTORS.md: new types are reviewed, not minted freely).

_checked.note: CORPUS: unique sales-pipeline source adapter in the organ corpus; no duplicate. Faithfully mirrors discovery-engine app/services/ae_adapters/sales_adapter.py (ACTIONABLE_STAGES, TIM_PERSONA_PROJECT_ID=8, days_in_stage DESC then deal_value DESC ranking, sales-{tenant}-{stage}-{slug} correlation_id); 35/35 tests pass. OSS: no permissive drop-in library exists for selecting actionable internal-pipeline deals + ranking them to feed an internal persona under the always-fed candidate contract; market builds custom (pandas) or uses full CRM apps. Adopting a dep would regress the stdlib-only pure-organ contract. Audited item #19879.
